description: The same sign-in card, narrated: every step carries the subtitle a reader sees while the recording plays, and the run writes the same text beside the video as a WebVTT file. Each step also writes the line the voice says, which is not the subtitle — a sentence is heard over several seconds, a subtitle is read at a glance.

steps.name: open the sign-in page
steps.caption: Open the sign-in page for your workspace.
steps.say: First, let's open the sign-in page for your workspace.

steps.name: the form is on screen, still signing in with a password
steps.caption: Sign in with the address and password you already use.
steps.say: You'll use the same email and password as always — nothing new to remember.

steps.name: fill the email
steps.caption: Type the email address on your account.
steps.say: Start with the email address tied to your account.

steps.name: fill the password
steps.caption: Then the password.
steps.say: Type the password that goes with that address.

steps.name: sign in
steps.caption: Choose Sign in.
steps.say: Press Sign in when you're ready.

steps.name: the workspace is on screen
steps.caption: You land in your workspace, signed in.
steps.say: And you're in — your workspace opens already signed in.
